messages:
nora: Preparing RC for embeddings-service. target cut 11:00 PT. quick litmus + KV heat + 15% canary. who can own final sign-off?

devon: I can take promo. artifact is embeddings@2026-03-23-rc4.

deploy-bot: Candidate created: embeddings@2026-03-23-rc4 (id: cand-1755556666). CI green. KV warm recommended.

qa-bot: Litmus running (smoke + regressions). ETA ~5m.

qa-bot: Litmus report: 119/120, one formatting mismatch. low severity.

nora: paste failing example pls.

devon: sample:

`input: "Show invoice" expected "Invoice total: $45.00" actual "Total: $45.00"`

nora: ok minor template tweak. apply runtime revert then re-run.

ops-bot: Applied runtime config override on cand-1755556666: message.template -> stable-v1 (audit cfg-1755).

qa-bot: Re-run: 120/120 pass :white_check_mark:.

nora: starting KV warm and traffic-split 15%. cmds:
`./deployctl kv-warm --candidate=cand-1755556666 --timeout=12m`
`./deployctl traffic-split --candidate=cand-1755556666 --pct=15`

deploy-bot: KV warm started. traffic split set to 15%.

infra-monitor: Observing p95/p99 during warm. initial metrics stable.

nora: propose pinning for a 90m promo window and reserve rollback slot. abort rule: sustained error_rate >0.5% for 5m.

sheriff: acknowledged. i'll be on watch and can trigger rollback.

nora: pinned (pin-1755556666) and created RB ticket RB-9022.

-- 11:03 PT --

deploy-bot: Promotion started for cand-1755556666 -> prod, rolling in 4 cohorts.

infra-monitor: Cohort 2 (25%) saw a brief p99 bump in us-west at t+80s; trace: cache eviction storm.

leo: scaling cache pool +1 in us-west.

infra-monitor: metrics normalized after autoscale. p99 back to baseline.

sheriff: ok to continue.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete: cand-1755556666 -> prod :shipit:.

nora: Promo successful. @leo can you add a short release note to RB-9022 mentioning the template revert and KV warm?

leo: Added: "embeddings-service RC4 promoted. Applied runtime template revert to preserve wording; performed KV warm and 15% canary. No model change."

nora: thanks all, closing thread. :tada:
